newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algeria's state industry output prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's state industry output prices rise.

text.p: Industrial production prices in Algeria's state sector, excluding its dominant energy sector, rose 7.7 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the same period in 1996, the National Statistic Office said.

But the price increases had slowed, it said in a report carried by the official news agency APS on Thursday, which pointed out that prices had jumped 25.7 percent in the first quarter of 1996 compared with the same period in the previous year.
There had been a "relatively moderate increase of 0.9 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the fourth quarter of 1996," the statistics office said.
Prices had been affected by a sharp rise in energy costs, mainly electricity, it said.
